entities.name: 代码评审 (code review)
entities.how_described: 本集主线:AI 智能体让代码产出暴涨但人类评审速度不变,评审成为新瓶颈,正被重构为工程化系统,人类从逐行读代码的『引擎』变为『飞行员』。

evidence.quote: Thank you for following on a session about the death of the code review with a session about the death of the code review.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: The problem is that the route to production still runs through humans, and the human steps, in particular code review, choke everything downstream.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Cursor is also doing an enormous amount of code review.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So after all that evidence, after all of that review of what the world is doing about automated code reviews, where I land is that code review isn't completely dead, but it is changing an enormous amount.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Humans are moving from being the engine that drives a code review, reading code line by line, to its pilots.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 智能体 (agent)
entities.how_described: 本集说智能体让开发者多写 741% 的代码但发布只多 30%,现在连评审工作也在被推给『智能体审智能体』的循环。

evidence.quote: If you do the math on that, that means that a 10,000 line agent pull request at that pace would take three or four working days to get a real human review.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: That is one pull request from one agent, 10,000 lines is absolutely, you know, absolutely an expectable number of lines of code for an agent that is doing a lot of work for you.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Even the scaffolding of the agent to review the agent and stuff like that was also written by agents.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: We've pushed almost all review effort towards being handled agent to agent.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Cursor's reviewer now spawns a fix agent from its own findings, so it doesn't just flag the bug.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Codex reviews its own changes, then calls in more agents to review those reviews in a loop until every agent reviewer is satisfied.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And they expose the whole logging stack to the agent.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: He told people, just ship, let the agent do its thing.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: A study in March this year reinforced that vulnerable code dressed up in an innocent commit message fooled an autonomous review agent in 88% of attempts.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 提示词注入 (prompt injection)
entities.how_described: 本集指出 Anthropic 的自动安全审查器明写『未针对提示词注入攻击加固』,研究显示漏洞代码骗过自动审查智能体的成功率 88%,骗过人类只有 35%。

evidence.quote: Anthropic ships an automated security reviewer, and in its readme it has a huge caveat, which is this action is not hardened against prompt injection attacks.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Cognition, the makers of Devon, built a benchmark around the maintainer's actual question, which is would you merge this?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Sarah Guo, who is a prominent investor in AI, wrote about it and said that solving for that benchmark, a benchmark of genuine mergeability, will be a critical turning point in the development of coding models
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So a benchmark of mergeability, if we could make one, wouldn't only be a measurement, it would immediately become a training signal for the frontier models, which means maintainability, scope, discipline, regression safety.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: That is not a benchmark.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Benchmark scaffolds have been caught leaking answers.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Every layer of that system, the benchmark, the classifier, the rubric, the test suite, the evals, is itself unreviewed until somebody decides that that is their job.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 误报 (false positives)
entities.how_described: 本集说误报是自动化评审员的头号杀手,Cursor 靠八轮评审加打乱顺序过滤误报,北大团队验证多轮保留一致结论可提升质量最多 44%。

evidence.quote: What they were doing was filtering for false positives because an automated reviewer that flags something as bad when it's actually good is going to get ignored.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: The multi-pass trick keeps getting rediscovered because false positives are the thing that kill a reviewer, and it actually works.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: GitHub
entities.how_described: 本集说 GitHub 的 Copilot 评审员已完成 6000 万次评审,占 GitHub 全部代码评审的五分之一以上,机器评审已是主流默认。

evidence.quote: Recently, three economists tracked more than 100,000 GitHub developers, matched them against telemetry that showed exactly when each one started using AI.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: One company is GitHub.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: GitHub is Copilot's reviewer has done 60 million reviews and now accounts for more than one in five code reviews on all of GitHub.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And GitHub and Cursor are by no means the only vendors getting into this game.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: Cursor
entities.how_described: 本集详细介绍 Cursor 公开的评审员架构:八轮评审过滤误报、告诉模型『不要默认信任代码』、评审员还会生成修复智能体写补丁。

evidence.quote: Cursor is also doing an enormous amount of code review.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Cursor has published its reviewers' architecture, so we know how they're doing this.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And it's not just Cursor who's doing this, there's research about it.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So then Cursor rebuilt their code reviewer so that the model reasons over the diff, calls tools, and decides where to dig.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Cursor's reviewer now spawns a fix agent from its own findings, so it doesn't just flag the bug.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: The next thing Cursor wants to do is the reviewer running the code to prove its own bug report is real.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And GitHub and Cursor are by no means the only vendors getting into this game.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Cursor calls it the resolution rate, and it has driven it from 52% to over 70%.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: OpenAI
entities.how_described: 本集说 OpenAI 用三名工程师让智能体从空仓库写出约一百万行代码,声称『人类可以审查 pull request 但不是必须的』;2024 年还训练了评审模型 Critic GPT。

evidence.quote: Andre Karpathy, who is one of OpenAI's founding engineers, has made the same argument about taking yourself out of the loop because the human in the loop is holding the system back.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: In February this year, OpenAI published an account of building an internal product with, in their words, no manually written code.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: I think the interesting thing about the OpenAI experiment is that they did not tell us what the product did and they did not release an open source product saying, and this is how we did it and this is how you should do it, which suggests to me that there are still holes in that strategy.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: If OpenAI says that you can do it, maybe you can do it.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: OpenAI says that's one thing you can do.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: We have seen this happen already, which is that in 2024, OpenAI trained a model called Critic GPT to catch bugs in model-written code.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So OpenAI built a model to review the models in order to clean the training, and it created a training signal that's now built into the models.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So let's go back to OpenAI who have pushed this the first list because they show what skipping human review costs.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: OpenAI made Codex bootable at every single change so that Codex can actually run a copy of Codex
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: OpenAI is running, lived with the results.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: Anthropic
entities.how_described: 本集提到 Anthropic 的 Nicholas Carlini 让 16 个智能体无人在环写出 C 编译器,其自动化安全审查器在 readme 里承认未针对提示词注入加固。

evidence.quote: Stripe, in Anthropic's launch materials for Fable this year, reported migrating a 50 million line Ruby codebase in a single day, which is work that they'd estimated would take over two months for a team.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Bun, which is now part of Anthropic, reported that they migrated over a million lines of Zig to Rust in six days.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: In February this year, Anthropic's Nicholas Carlini had 16 agents build a C compiler from scratch in Rust.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Anthropic ships an automated security reviewer, and in its readme it has a huge caveat, which is this action is not hardened against prompt injection attacks.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So Anthropic's code reviewer can be talked out of its findings by the very thing that it is reviewing.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Cognition, the makers of Devon, built a benchmark around the maintainer's actual question, which is would you merge this?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: Bun
entities.how_described: 本集说 Bun(现属 Anthropic)六天把上百万行代码从 Zig 移植到 Rust,测试通过 99.8%,但移植代码里藏着 13,044 个 unsafe 块,比同等人类代码多三个数量级。

evidence.quote: Bun, which is now part of Anthropic, reported that they migrated over a million lines of Zig to Rust in six days.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: But there are some big caveats on that BUN experiment.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 生产环境 (production)
entities.how_described: 本集说一旦合并前评审全是机器,观察代码上线后实际做了什么的生产环境就成了最后一个屹立不倒的审查者。

evidence.quote: The problem is that the route to production still runs through humans, and the human steps, in particular code review, choke everything downstream.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: That is a large production deployment.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Researchers disagree on how to review quality at all, which leaves one reviewer that you can't automate and you can't skip, which is production.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: But if you're shipping automatically reviewed code, then systems in production that review what it actually does in the wild become indispensable.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00
